note: The two sets are content-identical apart from trivial wording differences ("science mode" vs "science" in two conditions), so neither gains an advantage. Both share the same errors: the IFS field of view is misread as 0.38"×0.38" instead of 3.8"×3.8", the IFS detector temperature 60 K is misbound as a readout rate, and one quote misreads "planned variant" as "planar variant". Both also duplicate the IFS 1k×1k format and the table bandpass values (stated once with a vague entity and once bound to a channel), and both omit notable facts such as the CCD201 operating at 153K and 1 kHz readout during thruster firing and the LMAPD cooled to 60K.
remarks: Both extractions appear to come from the same pipeline output; the only deltas are condition wording and claim ordering. Shared defects worth fixing: the 3.8" IFS FOV decimal error, the temperature-as-readout-rate binding, the 'planned'/'planar' quote transcription, and the redundant table rows extracted twice under both a generic entity (e.g. 'UV bandpass | range') and a channel-bound entity. Facts both sets miss: CCD201 at 153K with 1 kHz readout during thruster firing, the 32×32 pupil image with 12 cm pixels, the LMAPD (Saphira) guide detector cooled to 60K, and the coronagraph statements (20% bandwidth state of the art, 0.45–1.0 µm requiring four observations, two coronagraphs specified).
